The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business development, sales strategy, and relationship management, ensuring that TOEFL remains the preferred English proficiency test for academic and professional advancement. Responsibilities •Develop and execute strategies to increase TOEFL test registrations in Egypt and key regional markets. •Build strong partnerships with universities, ministries, scholarship programs, language schools, test centers, and corporate clients. •Enhance TOEFL’s visibility and reputation among academic institutions and government entities while ensuring its widespread recognition. •Conduct presentations, webinars, and workshops to promote TOEFL and educate stakeholders. •Represent TOEFL at industry events, academic fairs, and professional conferences. •Engage with policymakers involved in higher education and English language policies, fostering long-term collaboration. •Provide sales reports, forecasts, and market insights to support decision-making and strategic planning. •Work closely with internal teams and regional partners to align sales strategies with broader marketing and business objectives. Qualifications & Experience •Minimum of five years of sales experience, preferably in education, exam sales, or EdTech. •Proven track record in developing partnerships and driving demand for educational products or assessments. •Strong understanding of the higher education sector and English proficiency testing landscape. •Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. •Fluency in English & Arabic (C1 level in both written and verbal communication). Location & Work Environment •Based in Egypt with a hybrid work model. •Frequent travel across Egypt and select regional markets (GCC & North Africa) is required. Why Join Us? •Be part of an organization dedicated to expanding educational opportunities. •Work in a dynamic, multicultural environment with a mission-driven approach. •Engage with leading institutions, government entities, and international partners. •Enjoy a role that offers strategic impact, career growth, and regional exposure. To Apply Please send your CV to: hr@nen-global.org WhatsApp (Text Only): 01275842400
